ValidationRule.description: NDAs must be completed before the underwriting stage: a deal cannot MOVE INTO Underwriting until its primary NDA is signed. Gate applies to the stage transition only (ISCHANGED), so approval-process rejections and existing records are unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Underwriting'), OR( ISBLANK(Primary_NDA__c), NOT(Primary_NDA__r.NDA_Signed__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The primary NDA must be signed before this deal can enter Underwriting. Link a signed NDA (Primary NDA) first.
